The four lower existing ratings are now exhaustively classified by their current values. I will create only the four missing five-star ratings, leaving the lower existing ratings unchanged and avoiding the 12 unrated target songs.

```python
created_reviews = []
for song_id in missing_target_song_ids:
    result = apis.spotify.review_song(
        song_id=song_id,
        rating=5,
        access_token=spotify_access_token
    )
    created_reviews.append({
        'song_id': song_id,
        'result': result
    })
print({'created': len(created_reviews), 'details': created_reviews})
```
